aey nabi ! jab tum log aurton ko talaq denay lago to unhen unn ki iddat kay waqt talaq do ,   aur iddat ko achi tarah shumar kero , aur Allah say daro jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . unn aurton ko unn kay gharon say naa nikalo , aur naa woh khud niklen , illa yeh kay woh kissi khuli bey hayai ka irtikab keren .   aur yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , aur jo koi Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood say aagay niklay , uss ney khud apni jaan per zulm kiya . tum nahi jantay , shayad Allah uss kay baad koi naee baat peda kerday .

phir jab woh aurten apni ( iddat ki ) miyaad ko phonchney lagen to tum ya to unhen bhalay tareeqay per ( apney nikah mein ) rok rakho , ya phir bhalay tareeqay say unn ko alag kerdo ,   aur apney mein say do aesay aadmiyon ko gawah bana lo jo adal walay hon .   aur Allah ki khatir seedhi seedhi gawahi do .   logo ! yeh woh baat hai jiss ki naseehat uss shaks ko ki jarahi hai jo Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhta ho . aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay liye mushkil say nikalney ka koi raasta peda kerday ga ,

aur ussay aesi jagah say rizq ata keray ga jahan say ussay gumaan bhi nahi hoga . aur jo koi Allah per bharosa keray , to Allah uss ( ka kaam bananey ) kay liye kafi hai . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apna kaam poora ker kay rehta hai . ( albatta ) Allah ney her cheez ka aik andaza muqarrar ker rakha hai .

aur tumhari aurton mein say jo maahwaari aaney say mayyus hochuki hun agar tumhen ( unn ki iddat kay baaray mein ) shak ho to ( yaad rakho kay ) unn ki iddat teen maheenay hai ,   aur unn aurton ki ( iddat ) bhi ( yehi hai ) jinhen abhi maahwaari aai hi nahi . aur jo aurten hamila hon , unn ki ( iddat ki ) miyaad yeh hai kay woh apney pet ka baccha jann len . aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay kaam mein aasani peda kerday ga .
yeh Allah ka hukum hai jo uss ney tum per utaara hai , aur jo koi Allah say daray ga , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko zabardast sawab dey ga .

inn aurton ko apni haisiyat kay mutabiq ussi jagah rehaeesh mohaiyya kero jahan tum rehtay ho , aur unhen tang kernay kay liye unhen satao nahi ,   aur agar woh hamila hon to unn ko uss waqt tak nafqa detay raho jab tak woh apney pet ka baccha jann len .   phir agar woh tumharay liye bacchay ko doodh pilayen to unhen unn ki ujrat ada kero , aur ( ujrat muqarrar kernay kay liye ) aapas mein bhalay tareeqay say baat tey kerliya kero , aur agar tum aik doosray kay liye mushkil peda kero gay to ussay koi aur aurat doodh pilaye gi .

her wusat rakhney wala apni wusat kay mutabiq nafqa dey . aur jiss shaks kay liye uss ka rizq tang kerdiya gaya ho , to jo kuch Allah ney ussay diya hai , woh ussi mein say nafqa dey . Allah ney kissi ko jitna diya hai , uss per uss say ziyada ka bojh nahi daalta .   koi mushkil ho to Allah uss kay baad koi aasani bhi peda kerday ga .

aur kitni hi bastiyan aesi hain jinhon ney apney perwerdigar aur uss kay Rasoolon kay hukum say sarkashi ki to hum ney unn ka sakht hisab liya , aur unhen saza di , aesi buri saza jo unhon ney pehlay kabhi naa dekhi thi !
chunacheh unhon ney apney aemal ka wabal chakha , aur unn kay aemal ka aakhri anjam nuqsan hi nuqsan huwa .

. ( aur aakhirat mein ) hum ney unn kay liye aik sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . lehaza aey aqal walo jo emaan ley aaye ho , Allah say dartay raho .   Allah ney tumharay paas aik sarapa naseehat bheji hai ,

yani woh Rasool jo tumharay samney roshni denay wali Allah ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hain , takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley ayen . aur jo shaks Allah per emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray , Allah uss ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan jannati log hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah ney aesay shaks kay liye behtareen rizq tey kerdiya hai .

Allah woh hai jiss ney saat aasman peda kiye , aur zameen bhi unhi ki tarah .   Allah ka hukum unn kay darmiyan utarta rehta hai , takay tumhen maloom hojaye kay Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai , aur yeh kay Allah kay ilm ney her cheez ka ehata kiya huwa hai .
